job.title: Security Engineer, IAM
job.pay_full: $193,500 – $261,900 a year in US Zone 2; $172,000 – $232,800 a year in US Zone 3 (not available in US Zone 1)

details.about: Dropbox's security engineers protect its products and the millions of people who use them. This role builds and runs the identity and access controls that let Dropbox employees, services and AI agents reach what they need securely, working with Infrastructure, Corp Engineering, Developer Platform and Incident Response.
duties: Design, deploy and operate IAM controls across Dropbox's cloud and on-premises infrastructure
Build identity, authentication and authorization controls for AI agents and other non-human actors
Enforce least privilege with RBAC, ABAC, permission boundaries, service control policies and just-in-time access
Design secure integrations with SAML, OAuth 2.1, OpenID Connect, SCIM and SPIFFE/SPIRE
Automate identity lifecycle processes and build guardrails with infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code
Build monitoring and alerting for anomalous logins, privilege escalation and credential misuse, and work with Incident Response on identity incidents
Run security reviews and threat modeling for new identity designs, and keep IAM services reliable, including on-call support
needs: 5+ years of security engineering experience, including substantial IAM or identity-security work
Hands-on experience with Okta, Okta for AI Agents and SailPoint, or comparable technologies
Strong grasp of authentication, authorization, least privilege, zero trust and identity lifecycle management
Experience with SAML, OAuth 2.0/2.1, OpenID Connect, SCIM and MFA, and designing RBAC or ABAC models
Experience securing human and non-human identities (services, workloads, automation, CI/CD)
Experience with agentic frameworks and MCP tool integration
Experience with access reviews, privileged-access controls and joiner/mover/leaver workflows
At least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, Java, Ruby or Bash, plus infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, APIs and security automation
Bachelor's in Computer Science, Information Security or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
nice: Workload identity (SPIFFE/SPIRE, Kubernetes service accounts, cloud workload identity)
Just-in-time access, zero-standing-privilege or privileged-access management platforms
Identity threat detection and response; IAM for multi-account cloud environments
NIST SP 800-63 and 800-207, CIS benchmarks; SOC 2, ISO 27001 or FedRAMP programs
Certifications such as CISSP or CCSP
details.benefits: Base pay $193,500 – $261,900 a year in US Zone 2 and $172,000 – $232,800 a year in US Zone 3; the role is not available in US Zone 1.
notes: Engineers on teams with an on-call rotation take part in it, including outside core business hours
